articles.title: Expected Harm: Rethinking Safety Evaluation of (Mis)Aligned LLMs
articles.abstract: Current evaluations of LLM safety predominantly rely on severity-based taxonomies to assess the harmfulness of models' responses to malicious queries. We argue that this formulation requires re-examination as it implicitly equates model output with realized harm while neglecting Execution Likelihood-the conditional probability of a threat being realized by a real-world actor given a model's response. In this work, we introduce Expected Harm, a metric that weights the severity of a jailbreak by its execution likelihood, modeled as a function of execution cost. Through empirical analysis of state-of-the-art models, we reveal a systematic Inverse Risk Calibration: models disproportionately exhibit stronger refusal behaviors for low-likelihood (high-cost) threats while remaining vulnerable to high-likelihood (low-cost) queries. Mechanistically, we first provide an analysis using linear probing, revealing that while refusal mechanisms linearly separate queries by severity, they do not use execution likelihood as an indicator for refusal. Then, we use Olmo-3's open-source staged checkpoints to trace the root cause of miscalibration to the Supervised Fine Tuning (SFT) training data distribution (82.8% of safety examples at cost levels 0-1) and show that cost representations are weak from the SFT stage onward. Finally, we demonstrate that this miscalibration creates a vulnerability: by exploiting this property, we increase the attack success rate of existing jailbreaks by up to $2\times$.
articles.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Dataset Track (spotlight paper)
articles.titleCn: 预期危害：重新思考（错位）对齐大型语言模型的（安全）评估
articles.abstractCn: 当前对大型语言模型安全的评估主要依赖基于严重性的分类法来评估模型对恶意查询的响应危害性。我们认为这一方法需要重新审视，因为它在隐式地将模型输出等同于实际危害的同时，忽视了执行可能性——即给定模型响应，威胁被现实行为者实现的条件概率。在这项工作中，我们引入了预期危害度，这是一个将逃逸的严重性与其执行可能性相乘的指标，执行可能性被建模为执行成本函数。通过对最先进模型的实证分析，我们揭示了一种系统性的逆风险校准现象：模型在低可能性（高成本）威胁上表现出不成比例的强烈拒绝行为，而在高可能性（低成本）查询上仍然容易受到攻击。从机制上讲，我们首先使用线性探测进行分析，揭示虽然拒绝机制能线性区分查询的严重性，但它们并未将执行可能性作为拒绝的指标。然后，我们使用Olmo-3的开源分阶段检查点来追踪校准错误到监督微调（SFT）训练数据分布的根源（82.8%的安全示例位于成本级别0-1），并表明成本表示从SFT阶段开始就较弱。最后，我们证明这种校准错误造成了一种漏洞：通过利用这一特性，我们使现有逃逸攻击的成功率提高了高达2倍。

articles.title: Controllable User Simulation
articles.abstract: Using offline datasets to evaluate conversational agents often fails to cover rare scenarios or to support testing new policies. This has motivated the use of controllable user simulators for targeted, counterfactual evaluation, typically implemented by prompting or fine-tuning large language models. In this work, we formalize controllable simulation as a causal inference problem. By bridging natural language evaluation with off-policy evaluation methodology, we show that the standard practice of training simulators via supervised fine-tuning on post-hoc trajectory labels yields a structurally biased model. Specifically, these labels are inextricably coupled to the data-generating behavior policy, injecting a look-ahead bias that breaks causal consistency. Furthermore, we prove that under policy shift this failure causes the variance of evaluation metrics to explode geometrically, a phenomenon we term controllability collapse. To restore causal consistency, we establish theoretical conditions for accurate simulation and propose practical training mitigations: a priori controls, step-wise dynamic controls, and direct policy-conditioned learning. Empirical evaluation confirms that while standard global controls distort conversational distributions and collapse behavioral diversity, our causally grounded simulators eliminate look-ahead bias, preserve natural variance, and exhibit robust zero-shot generalization to unseen agent behaviors.
articles.abstractCn: 使用离线数据集评估对话代理往往无法涵盖罕见场景或支持新策略的测试。这促使人们使用可控用户模拟器进行有针对性的反事实评估，通常通过提示或微调大型语言模型来实现。在这项工作中，我们将可控模拟形式化为一个因果推理问题。通过将自然语言评估与离策略评估方法相结合，我们表明，通过后验轨迹标签进行监督微调来训练模拟器的标准做法会产生结构偏差模型。具体来说，这些标签与生成数据的策略密不可分，注入了预见偏差，破坏了因果一致性。此外，我们证明了在策略变化下，这种失败会导致评估指标的方差呈几何级数爆炸，我们将这种现象称为可控性崩溃。为了恢复因果一致性，我们建立了精确模拟的理论条件，并提出了实用的训练缓解措施：先验控制、逐步动态控制和直接策略条件学习。实证评估证实，虽然标准的全局控制会扭曲对话分布并导致行为多样性崩溃，但我们的基于因果的模拟器消除了预见偏差，保留了自然方差，并表现出对未见代理行为的稳健零样本泛化能力。

articles.title: From Association to Causation: Improving Retrieval Precision of Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Causal Relations and an Attention Mechanism
articles.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM generation on retrieved documents, but the standard terminal retrieval stage--dense-vector similarity, optionally followed by reranking--often returns documents that share keywords with the query without containing the needed information, a failure mode that grows with the knowledge base. We trace it to a conceptual gap: similarity captures only associational relations, whereas the documents that matter are linked to the query causally. We model the terminal retrieval stage with a causal graph grounded in Reichenbach's common cause principle: the keywords shared by the query and a retrieved document form a latent common cause A, and the document's residual keywords form a latent set B linking the document to the ideal output. Since a retrieved document is a collider (A -> d <- B), retrieval itself opens an associational path between the query and B, which licenses a training-free, attention-style re-scoring rule: the cosine similarity between the query embedding and the weighted centroid embedding of B. Unlike causality-enhanced RAG variants that model causal relations inside the knowledge content, our graph models the causal structure of the retrieval process itself. On a real 471-document enterprise knowledge base, the method promotes a relevant guideline from rank 6 to the top 3; on a controlled diagnostic corpus reproducing the keyword-stuffing regime, it improves the mean target rank from 2.88 to 1.25, while a trained cross-encoder reranker barely helps (2.63). Conversely, on three BEIR benchmarks the score underperforms the similarity baseline, delineating the applicability boundary: the method guards the keyword-stuffing regime of growing proprietary knowledge bases and complements neural rerankers; a corpus-level calibration gate selects the correct regime with >= 95% reliability. A fully local testbed demonstrates deployability.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, 1 algorithm. Code available at https://github.com/Silk-Road/causal-rag-rerank
articles.titleCn: 从关联到因果：通过因果关系和注意力机制提升检索增强生成模型的检索精度
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）将大型语言模型（LLM）的生成基于检索到的文档，但标准的终端检索阶段——密集向量相似度，有时会跟后续重排序——往往返回与查询共享关键词但不含所需信息的文档，这种失效模式随着知识库的增长而加剧。我们将其归因于一个概念上的差距：相似度仅捕捉关联关系，而关键文档与查询之间存在因果关系。我们用基于赖兴巴赫共同原因原则的因果图来建模终端检索阶段：查询与检索到的文档共享的关键词形成一个潜在共同原因A，而文档的剩余关键词形成一个潜在集合B，将文档与理想输出关联起来。由于检索到的文档是一个碰撞器（A -> d <- B），检索本身就在查询和B之间打开了一条关联路径，从而允许一种无需训练、类似注意力机制的重评分规则：查询嵌入与B的加权质心嵌入之间的余弦相似度。与在知识内容内部建模因果关系的因果增强RAG变体不同，我们的图模型关注的是检索过程本身的因果结构。在一个包含471份文档的真实企业知识库上，该方法将一条相关指南从第6名提升到前三名；在一个复现关键词填充策略的控制诊断语料库上，它将平均目标排名从2.88提升到1.25，而一个训练好的跨编码器重排序器几乎没什么帮助（2.63）。相反，在三个BEIR基准测试中，该方法的得分低于相似度基线，划定了适用边界：该方法保护了不断增长的自有知识库的关键词填充策略，并补充了神经重排序器；语料库级别的校准门以≥95%的可靠性选择正确策略。一个完全本地的测试平台展示了其可部署性。

articles.title: What Does a Harness Repair? Three Preregistered Studies Around a Longevity-Tuned Language Model
articles.abstract: A harness search around a frozen longevity-tuned 1.7B model reported a rescue. An audit found that the gain came from rows the start left unparsed, that the caller sent each row's reference answer as an assistant turn, and that replication through the same pipeline missed it. Is a harness's gain more than a constant answer would give? We preregistered three studies and report every endpoint. In the first two, thinking off raised test accuracy over a capped thinking setting in 7 of 12 cells, mostly on rows the cap left unparsed. It was not meaningfully worse than a rescue in 7 of 9 small-model test cells or than four GEPA harnesses at 1.7B. Replication reproduced an injected defect's distortion in 9 of 20 evaluable cases (7 fixed by design). At 14B, two GEPA harnesses beat thinking off by 34 points on test but were not detectably above the strongest constant label, and answered "Yes" in 94.6% and 98.2% of parsed mortality answers on test. In the third study (SmolLM3-3B, base Qwen3-1.7B), GEPA beat the constant on FPB (confirmatory, both partitions); thinking off was not meaningfully worse than any BoolQ harness, and 3 of 4 MMLU-Pro searches kept their seed (the fourth inconclusive on test). On Autocast (exploratory), the harnesses were within 0.7 points of the constant and gave one label in 93.1% to 96.8% of parsed answers, both on test. On questions about the input or about knowledge (FPB, BoolQ, MMLU-Pro), GEPA beat the constant or found no clear gain over thinking off; on questions that ask for a prediction (14B mortality, descriptive; Autocast, exploratory), the harness ended near the constant and gave one label almost throughout while its gain over thinking off looked large. The constant label told the two apart wherever the gain was large. This rests on few tasks that also differ in label skew, number of labels and task type, so it is not shown to depend on the kind of question.
articles.comment: 90 pages, 3 figures, 77 tables. v3 adds a third preregistered study (SmolLM3-3B and base Qwen3-1.7B on BoolQ, FPB and MMLU-Pro; Autocast exploratory) and a check of the selected harness texts, and withholds row-like passages that v1 and v2 printed. Ancillary files in anc/: frozen preregistrations, addenda (row keys withheld), aggregate reports, README, sha256sum list
articles.titleCn: 一个修理架有什么作用？围绕一个寿命调优语言模型的三个预先注册研究
articles.abstractCn: 一项针对冻结的1.7B模型进行调优的搜索实验报告了改进效果。审计发现，这种改进源于未解析的起始行，调用者将每行的参考答案作为助手回应发送，而通过相同管道的复制过程未能发现这一问题。一个搜索实验的收益是否超过一个固定答案所能提供的收益？我们预先注册了三项研究，并报告了所有评估指标。在前两项研究中，"思考关闭"（thinking off）在12个单元格中的7个单元格里，相对于限制思考的设置提高了测试准确率，主要针对那些限制未解析的行。在9个小模型的测试单元格中的7个单元格里，其表现与"救援"（rescue）没有显著差异，或者与四个1.7B规模的GEPA搜索实验相当。在20个可评估案例中的9个案例里，复制过程重现了注入缺陷的扭曲（其中7个通过设计修复）。在14B规模的模型中，两个GEPA搜索实验在测试中比"思考关闭"高出34个百分点，但并未显著高于最强的固定标签，并且在测试中解析的死亡预测答案中分别以94.6%和98.2%的比例给出"是"的答案。在第三项研究（SmolLM3-3B，基础模型为Qwen3-1.7B）中，GEPA在FPB（确认性，两个分区）上优于固定答案；"思考关闭"的表现与任何BoolQ搜索实验没有显著差异，其中4个MMLU-Pro搜索实验中有3个保持了其种子（第四个在测试中结果不确定）。在Autocast（探索性）实验中，搜索实验与固定答案的差距在0.7个百分点以内，并且在测试中给出正确答案的比例在93.1%到96.8%之间。对于关于输入或知识的问题（FPB、BoolQ、MMLU-Pro），GEPA优于固定答案或未发现比"思考关闭"有显著提升；而对于要求预测的问题（14B死亡预测、描述性；Autocast、探索性），搜索实验的结果接近固定答案，几乎在整个过程中给出单一标签，但其相对于"思考关闭"的收益看起来很大。固定标签能够区分出收益较大的情况。然而，这些研究基于少量任务，且这些任务在标签偏差、标签数量和任务类型上存在差异，因此并未证明其结果依赖于问题的类型。

articles.title: SOPO: Socratic Guided Policy Optimization for Span-Level Hallucination Detection
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained widespread adoption in various natural language processing tasks, but suffer from hallucination issues where they generate unfaithful or inconsistent content. While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown promising applications in reasoning tasks, its application to span-level hallucination detection is challenged by localization ambiguity, reward sparsity on hard examples, and uncontrolled length inflation. To address these issues, we introduce Socratic Guided Policy Optimization (SOPO), a multi-turn RL framework for robust hallucination detection. The key innovation of SOPO is a Socratic feedback mechanism, where a teacher model guides the reasoning trajectories during rollout by providing indirect hints inferred from the ground truth. This teacher-guided approach enables the model to generate more effective reasoning trajectories for hard examples, thus alleviating reward sparsity. Furthermore, we incorporate Turn-based Advantage Scaling to penalize verbosity bias, encouraging the model to develop efficient and autonomous reasoning capabilities. Empirical results on RAGTruth demonstrate that SOPO (4B) achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing leading proprietary models (e.g., GPT-5) and standard RL baselines, while obtaining higher reported mean scores than GRPO on four out-of-domain benchmarks, with mixed evidence against CAPO. We release our training and evaluation code alongside the 1.7B and 4B SOPO models at https://github.com/patsnap/SOPO.
articles.titleCn: SOPO：苏格拉底引导策略优化用于跨度级幻觉检测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在多种自然语言处理任务中得到了广泛应用，但存在幻觉问题，即它们生成的內容可能不真实或不一致。虽然带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在推理任务中展现出良好的应用前景，但其应用于片段级幻觉检测时面临定位模糊、困难样本奖励稀疏以及不受控的长度膨胀等挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了苏格拉底引导策略优化（SOPO），这是一种用于鲁棒幻觉检测的多轮强化学习框架。SOPO的关键创新在于引入了苏格拉底式反馈机制，该机制通过教师模型在推理过程中提供基于真实标签的间接提示来引导推理轨迹。这种教师引导方法使模型能够为困难样本生成更有效的推理轨迹，从而缓解奖励稀疏问题。此外，我们还结合了基于回合的优势缩放技术来惩罚冗长偏差，鼓励模型发展高效且自主的推理能力。在RAGTruth数据集上的实验结果表明，SOPO（4B）实现了当前最佳性能，超越了领先的专有模型（如GPT-5）和标准RL基线，同时在四个领域外基准测试中获得了比GRPO更高的平均得分，而CAPO的效果则存在争议。我们已将训练和评估代码以及1.7B和4B的SOPO模型发布在https://github.com/patsnap/SOPO。

articles.title: Unlimited OCR Works 2
articles.abstract: Unlimited OCR ushers the era of long-horizon parsing, substantially mitigating the growth of working memory as document lengthens. However, as document length scales to hundreds of pages, the visual context grows substantially, sharply increasing the computational cost of each decoding step and limiting the scalability of ultra-long document parsing. Inspired by human book transcription via localized focus without re-scanning preceding pages, we introduce Unlimited OCR 2, a document parsing model that looks only at what it transcribes. Building on Unlimited OCR, we upgrade all the decoder attention modules to Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA), bounding active reference tokens to a fixed capacity and thus sustaining constant computational costs across arbitrarily long documents. By combining SR-SWA with Unlimited-Horizon Decoding Paradigm, Unlimited OCR 2 enables document parsing over virtually unlimited lengths without prohibitive memory overhead. At the hundred-page scale, Unlimited OCR 2 achieves 7.0$\times$ and 5.6$\times$ per-step speedups over Full Attention and R-SWA, respectively. Furthermore, it delivers state-of-the-art end-to-end performance on both MPDocBench and MarathonDocBench, our newly proposed benchmark targeting hundred-page document parsing. Ultimately, the capacity for uninterrupted, one-shot document parsing signifies a fundamental paradigm shift into the OCR 3.0 era.
articles.abstractCn: Unlimited OCR引领了长时序解析的时代，显著缓解了随着文档长度增长而增加的工作记忆负担。然而，当文档长度扩展到数百页时，视觉上下文急剧增长，大幅提高了每一步解码的计算成本，限制了超长文档解析的可扩展性。受人类通过局部聚焦转录书籍而不重新扫描前几页的启发，我们推出了Unlimited OCR 2，这是一种仅关注其转录内容的文档解析模型。基于Unlimited OCR，我们将所有解码器注意力模块升级为稀疏参考滑动窗口注意力（SR-SWA），将活跃参考标记限制在固定容量内，从而在任意长度的文档中保持恒定的计算成本。通过结合SR-SWA与无限时序解码范式，Unlimited OCR 2实现了对几乎无限长度文档的解析，而不会带来过高的内存开销。在百页规模下，Unlimited OCR 2相较于全注意力机制和R-SWA分别实现了每步7.0倍和5.6倍的加速。此外，它在我们的新提出的基准MPDocBench和MarathonDocBench（针对百页文档解析的基准）上均达到了最先进的端到端性能。最终，不间断、一次性文档解析的能力标志着OCR 3.0时代的根本范式转变。

articles.title: MUON-RT Reusing the Teacher's Trajectory for Momentum-Free Muon for LLM Self-Distillation
articles.abstract: Self-distillation methods for large language models with an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher already retain a history of student updates. Muon nevertheless stores a separate momentum buffer, increasing persistent training memory. We propose Muon with Reused Teacher (Muon-RT), which reuses the teacher-student displacement to eliminate momentum buffers for hidden weight matrices. We show that this displacement encodes an exponentially weighted history of applied updates and smooths temporally uncorrelated noise under a local model. Muon-RT removes its radial component, normalizes it spectrally, and mixes it with the current gradient after Newton-Schulz (NS) orthogonalization. Under explicit regularity and alignment assumptions, we establish linear contraction of an expected objective-gap bound toward a residual error level. With Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Muon-RT improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.6 points with 42% less persistent memory, and over momentum Muon by 5.4 points with 27% less persistent memory. With Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) on Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, it improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.0 points.
articles.titleCn: 使用教师轨迹对无动量μ子进行LLM自蒸馏的MUON-RT
articles.abstractCn: 带有指数移动平均（EMA）教师的自蒸馏方法已经保留了学生更新的历史记录。Muon 仍然存储一个单独的动量缓冲区，增加了持久训练内存。我们提出了带有重用教师（Muon-RT）的Muon，该方案重用教师-学生的位移来消除隐藏权重矩阵的动量缓冲区。我们证明该位移编码了应用更新的指数加权历史，并在局部模型下平滑了时间不相关的噪声。Muon-RT 移除其径向分量，进行频谱归一化，并在牛顿-舒尔茨（NS）正交化后与当前梯度混合。在显式正则性和对齐假设下，我们建立了预期目标差距界限向残差误差水平线性收缩的结论。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上的自蒸馏微调（SDFT）中，Muon-RT 相比AdamW平均准确率提高了2.6个百分点，持久内存减少了42%；相比动量Muon平均准确率提高了5.4个百分点，持久内存减少了27%。在Olmo-3-7B-Instruct上的自蒸馏策略优化（SDPO）中，它相比AdamW平均准确率提高了2.0个百分点。

articles.title: Language Models Show a "Women-Are-Wonderful" Effect in Blame Attribution That is Not Just Leniency
articles.abstract: This paper investigates the Women-Are-Wonderful (WaW) effect in language-model blame attribution: a favorable bias in which women receive more positive evaluations than men. Using 11,270 interpersonal conflicts from r/AmItheAsshole, we construct matched counterfactuals that vary the gender of the person being judged (the original poster) and the person affected (the counter-party). Across four language models, gender changes a minority of verdicts, but those changes consistently favor women. The effect is strongly role-dependent. Making the original poster a woman reduces the odds of blame by 9--52%, while making the counter-party a woman multiplies them by 2.7--9.2X. Counter-party WaW also varies across conflict types, strengthening in communication and relationship conflicts and weakening in family conflicts. Exploratory probes suggest that counter-party gender can shift judgments of sympathy, reasonableness, harm and protection. WaW is therefore not just leniency toward women being judged: models also judge conduct more harshly when it affects a woman.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型在归咎责任时表现出“女性很棒”效应，这不仅仅是宽容
articles.abstractCn: 本文研究了语言模型在责任归因中的“女性很棒”（WaW）效应：一种女性比男性获得更多正面评价的有利偏见。通过分析r/AmItheAsshole中的11,270起人际冲突，我们构建了匹配反事实情境，其中被评判者（原帖作者）和受影响者（对方）的性别有所不同。在四个语言模型中，性别改变了少数裁决，但这些改变始终有利于女性。该效应与角色密切相关。将原帖作者设定为女性可降低被指责的几率9--52%，而将对方设定为女性则使被指责的几率增加2.7--9.2倍。对方的WaW效应也因冲突类型而异，在沟通和关系冲突中增强，而在家庭冲突中减弱。初步探索表明，对方的性别可以改变同情、合理性、伤害和保护的判断。因此，WaW不仅仅是被评判的女性受到宽容：模型在行为影响女性时也会更严厉地评判。

articles.title: HyperRepair: Recovering Forgotten General Capabilities of Fine-Tuned Language Models
articles.abstract: Fine-tuning improves a language model's performance in a target domain but can weaken its general capabilities. Existing methods often face a trade-off between general capabilities and domain specialization, making it difficult to preserve both. We introduce HyperRepair, a framework for recovering general capabilities while retaining domain specialization at only inference cost. To make recovery generalizable across models sharing a pretrained backbone, HyperRepair learns a hypernetwork from repairs trained on source models. The hypernetwork uses activation fingerprints that summarize changes from the pretrained backbone to generate a tailored Repairing Side Net (RSN), whose prompt-conditioned gate applies corrections selectively. This enables recovery on models from unseen adaptation domains without target-domain examples or additional optimization. We evaluate HyperRpair across two model families, 12 LoRA adaptation datasets, and 15 general benchmarks. On the default split, HyperRepair achieves 93.4% of the base models' average general score while retaining 99.5% of the fine-tuned models' average domain score.
articles.titleCn: HyperRepair：恢复微调语言模型的被遗忘的泛化能力
articles.abstractCn: 微调可以提高语言模型在目标领域的性能，但可能会削弱其通用能力。现有方法通常需要在通用能力和领域专业化之间进行权衡，这使得同时保持两者变得困难。我们引入了HyperRepair，这是一个在仅推理成本的情况下恢复通用能力并保留领域专业化的框架。为了使恢复具有跨共享预训练主干网络的模型的泛化能力，HyperRepair从在源模型上训练的修复中学习一个超网络。超网络使用激活指纹来总结从预训练主干网络的变化，以生成一个定制的修复侧网络（RSN），其提示条件门选择性地应用修正。这使得在不使用目标领域示例或额外优化的情况下，对来自未见过的适应领域的模型进行恢复。我们在两个模型系列、12个LoRA适应数据集和15个通用基准上评估了HyperRepair。在默认分割中，HyperRepair在保持微调模型平均领域得分的99.5%的同时，实现了基线模型平均通用得分的93.4%。

articles.title: Lineage Is Memory: Parent Inheritance and Feedback Disclosure in Short-Budget LLM-Guided Optimization
articles.abstract: Iterative language-model optimizers refine prompts and programs by evaluating a candidate, showing a proposer model a sample of failing cases, and keeping revisions that improve performance. Recent work attributes the limits of this loop to narrow single-round reflection, introducing full-set error clustering, targeted minibatches, or larger proposer models so the optimizer sees more failure modes per step. Yet every existing evaluation tests these mechanisms exclusively inside lineage-preserving search, where each revision edits a surviving parent, leaving the contribution of parent inheritance confounded with the breadth of per-round feedback. Across 1,750 pre-registered runs spanning nine prompt and program synthesis benchmarks, we separate parent inheritance from feedback disclosure under matched evaluation budgets. We find that greedy parent inheritance drives the vast majority of optimization progress, outperforming seed-reset resampling even when seed-reset proposals receive a clustered summary of all failures in every round or use a larger proposer model. While full-set error clustering and diverse failure selection improve single-step rewrites from the seed and accelerate the opening rounds of search, sequential parent inheritance rapidly closes this gap as solved error modes are retained in the candidate and filtered from subsequent failure lists. Moreover, decomposing token expenditure in GEPA reveals that proposer reflection accounts for only a small fraction of total cost whereas validation and minibatch gating consume nearly the entire budget, showing that greedy parent inheritance over raw failures captures the gains of complex reflective loops at a fraction of their compute.
articles.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Code, pre-registrations, and 1,750 run logs at https://github.com/shangliy/lineage-is-memory
articles.titleCn: 谱系即记忆：短预算下LLM引导优化中的父代继承与反馈披露
articles.abstractCn: 迭代式语言模型优化器通过评估候选方案、向提议模型展示失败案例样本，并保留提升性能的修订来优化提示和程序。近期研究将此循环的局限性归因于单一轮次的狭隘反思，通过引入全集错误聚类、目标化小批量或更大的提议模型，使优化器在每一步看到更多失败模式。然而，所有现有评估都专门在这些机制内部进行谱系保留搜索，其中每次修订都编辑一个存活的父方案，导致父方案继承的贡献与每轮反馈的广度相互混淆。在涵盖九个提示和程序合成基准的1,750次预先注册运行中，我们在匹配的评估预算下分离了父方案继承与反馈披露。我们发现贪婪的父方案继承驱动了绝大多数优化进程，即使种子重置的提议方案每轮都收到所有失败的聚类摘要或使用更大的提议模型，其表现仍优于种子重置重采样。虽然全集错误聚类和多样化的失败选择能提升种子单步重写并加速搜索的初始轮次，但顺序父方案继承能迅速缩小这一差距，因为已解决的错误模式被保留在候选方案中，并从后续失败列表中过滤。此外，分解GEPA中的令牌消耗揭示，提议模型的反思仅占总成本的一小部分，而验证和小批量门控几乎消耗了整个预算，表明贪婪的父方案继承通过原始失败捕获了复杂反思循环的收益，而计算成本却大幅降低。

articles.title: Context as Infrastructure: Knowledge Compilation for Retrieval in Agentic Systems with Harnesses
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation is becoming agentic. A search harness writes queries, reads results, reformulates, and decides when to stop. This largely solves accuracy: a harness with only BM25/grep and MiniMax M3 answers 85% of BrowseComp-Plus and 91% on multi-hop FRAMES in our runs, without compiled or vector indexes. It exposes a context problem: an undisciplined loop repeats queries, rereads documents, and fills the window with unused passages. The missing layer is knowledge compilation: a configurable ingestion pipeline where LLMs enrich documents with context no chunk contains alone--navigation hierarchies with claim-evidence leaves, entity graphs, timelines, mind maps, ontologies, wikis, and memory. Compilation is not a better retriever: under a competent harness, structural artifacts gave no detectable accuracy gain on FRAMES, and a PageIndex-style outline degraded at scale. It is a supply layer. A navigation tree whose leaves are claim-evidence pairs--the mechanism we measure--cuts query tokens by 91% when evidence suffices and adds 1.9% when it does not, a 38% average reduction; this implies a 2% break-even sufficiency rate and a measured rate near 43%. A decision gate cuts latency from 140 s to 30 s, though substitution's token saving is bought with retrieval rounds and carries its own latency cost. Other artifacts--ontology, graph, wiki, timeline, mind map, memory--pay off in deployment (governance, integration, onboarding, temporal orientation, continuity) where accuracy benchmarks cannot see them. We describe RAGFlow's pipeline and harness (open source at https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow), which turns the loop into five disciplined stations and keeps the context entering the model the smallest sufficient set; together they form an agent-native database: a store that hands the agent compiled, governed context instead of a ranked list of passages.
articles.titleCn: 情境即基础设施：为代理系统中的检索而进行的知识汇编
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成正在变得自主化。一个搜索驱动程序会编写查询、读取结果、重新表述，并决定何时停止。这很大程度上解决了准确性问题：在我们的测试中，仅使用BM25/grep和MiniMax M3的驱动程序在BrowseComp-Plus上回答了85%的问题，在多跳FRAMES上回答了91%，且无需编译或向量索引。它暴露了一个上下文问题：一个无纪律的循环会重复查询、重读文档，并用未使用的段落填满窗口。缺失的层次是知识编译：一个可配置的摄取管道，其中大型语言模型用单个片段无法包含的上下文来丰富文档——包括带有声明-证据叶的导航层次结构、实体图、时间线、思维导图、本体、维基和记忆。编译不是一个更好的检索器：在称职的驱动程序下，结构化工件在FRAMES上没有检测到可衡量的准确性提升，而PageIndex风格的概要在大规模下会退化。它是一个供应层。一个叶子为声明-证据对的导航树——即我们测量的机制——当证据足够时将查询标记减少91%，当证据不足时增加1.9%，平均减少38%；这意味着2%的盈亏平衡充足率，而测量率接近43%。一个决策门将延迟从140秒缩短到30秒，尽管替换节省的标记是以检索轮次为代价的，并带有自身的延迟成本。其他工件——本体、图、维基、时间线、思维导图、记忆——在部署时（治理、集成、入职、时间导向、连续性）得到回报，而准确性基准无法看到这些。我们描述了RAGFlow的管道和驱动程序（开源于https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow），它将循环转化为五个纪律严明的站点，并保持进入模型的上下文为最小的充足集合；它们共同构成了一个面向代理的数据库：一个将编译和治理的上下文交给代理的存储，而不是一个排序的段落列表。

articles.title: S2TDR: Structured Multimodal Reconstruction for Sticker-Aware Dialogue Understanding
articles.abstract: Stickers are widely used in social media dialogues to express affect, stance, and intent beyond literal text. Their meanings are often non-literal and context-dependent, making them difficult to handle with generic visual fusion or standalone captioning. We propose Sticker-to-Text Dialogue Reconstruction (S2TDR), a structured multimodal reconstruction framework that converts sticker turns into contextually appropriate textual utterances. S2TDR decomposes sticker interpretation into visual cue extraction, affective-intent inference, and context-aware dialogue reconstruction, using OCR text only as an auxiliary cue when available. The reconstructed dialogue can then be consumed by existing text-based dialogue models. Experiments on sentiment analysis, intent recognition, and dialogue summarization show that S2TDR generally improves multiple downstream models over direct sticker integration methods. Further analyses on component ablations, OCR-empty stickers, and reconstruction quality indicate that structured reconstruction provides an interpretable and effective way to integrate sticker semantics into dialogue understanding.
articles.titleCn: S2TDR：面向贴纸感知对话理解的结构化多模态重建
articles.abstractCn: 贴纸在社交媒体对话中被广泛用于表达字面意义之外的情感、立场和意图。它们的含义通常非字面化且依赖于上下文，这使得它们难以通过通用的视觉融合或独立的标题注释来处理。我们提出了贴纸到文本对话重建（S2TDR），这是一个结构化的多模态重建框架，将贴纸对话转换成符合上下文的文本话语。S2TDR将贴纸解读分解为视觉线索提取、情感意图推理和上下文感知对话重建，仅在可用时将OCR文本仅作为辅助线索使用。重建的对话可以被现有的基于文本的对话模型所消费。在情感分析、意图识别和对话摘要实验中显示，S2TDR通常比直接贴纸集成方法更能提升多个下游模型的表现。进一步对组件消融、OCR空白贴纸和重建质量的分析表明，结构化重建提供了一种可解释且有效的方法，将贴纸语义整合到对话理解中。

articles.title: TraceSpec: Understanding and Improving Speculative Decoding for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: LLM agents execute tasks through repeated model calls over evolving histories of reasoning, actions, and tool feedback. Aggregate speculative-decoding metrics merge these distinct decisions, providing limited guidance on where draft supervision is needed. We present TraceSpec, a framework connecting trajectory evaluation with adaptive draft training. It combines dynamic execution with fixed-prefix replay and introduces TraceSpec-Traj, a corpus of 10,000 training states and 2,500 test states spanning browsing and software engineering. Analysis of five speculative baselines reveals that aggregate acceptance can rise with context length while declining within matched late browsing actions. Workload and phase further distinguish these trends, motivating supervision guided by trajectory conditions. TraceSpec trains on intermediate assistant turns and allocates a fixed prediction budget using state-conditioned estimates of prefix-aware acceptance gaps. Across three target sizes and two temperatures, it improves replay throughput by 12.5% to 22.6% over its DSpark base. Qwen3-4B ablations show that adaptive allocation increases accepted length by 3.3% to 10.0% over fixed full-turn supervision, with additional comparisons substantiating the roles of state conditioning and consecutive-token agreement. The resulting evaluation resources, trajectory findings, and training strategy connect the analysis of agent execution to practical draft improvement.
articles.titleCn: TraceSpec：理解并改进LLM代理的推测解码
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理通过在推理历史、行动和工具反馈不断演变的进程中反复调用模型来执行任务。聚合的推测解码指标将这些不同的决策合并，仅能提供有限的指导，说明在哪里需要草稿监督。我们提出了TraceSpec框架，该框架将轨迹评估与自适应草稿训练相结合。它结合了动态执行和固定前缀重放，并引入了TraceSpec-Traj，这是一个包含10,000个训练状态和2,500个测试状态的语料库，涵盖浏览和软件工程领域。对五个推测基线的分析表明，聚合接受度会随着上下文长度的增加而上升，但在匹配的后期浏览行动中却下降。工作负载和阶段进一步区分了这些趋势，从而促使基于轨迹条件的监督。TraceSpec在中间助手回合上进行训练，并使用状态条件的前缀感知接受度差距估计来分配固定的预测预算。在三种目标大小和两种温度下，它比其DSpark基础提高了12.5%到22.6%的重放吞吐量。Qwen3-4B消融实验表明，自适应分配比固定的全回合监督使接受长度增加了3.3%到10.0%，额外的比较进一步证实了状态条件和连续标记一致性的作用。由此产生的评估资源、轨迹发现和训练策略将代理执行分析与实践草稿改进联系起来。

articles.title: Beyond Response Scoring: An AI-aware Cognitive Supervision Framework for Automated Mathematical Short Answer Grading
articles.abstract: Transformer-based language models have achieved remarkable success in automated short answer grading (ASAG). However, current methods in ASAG struggle to comprehend, reason about and evaluate complex mathematical answers involving symbols and formulas. These score-only methods fail to generalize across diverse responses and skill states associated with identical scores. Moreover, they ignore the potential upward bias introduced by generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) usage in assessing students' performance and knowledge mastery. To address these limitations, we propose AICG (AI-aware Cognitive-supervised Grading), a two-branch multi-task framework. The first branch combines RoBERTa-based regression, ordinal, and classification heads for individual-answer grading. The second branch uses an expert-designed Q-matrix to associate responses with assessed skills and jointly predicts G-DINA-derived skill mastery and learning gain. Through the shared encoder, these skill-level targets provide cognitive supervision for answer grading beyond score labels. AICG further uses a Gen-AI detector, trained through supervised contrastive pretraining followed by linear classification, to estimate assistance probabilities and convert them into reliability weights, attenuating unreliable cognitive evidence during learning assessment. We conduct experiments on 49,402 instructor-graded responses spanning 19 academic semesters. Relative to RoBERTa regression, AICG reduces mean absolute error (MAE) by 50.3% and improves quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) from 0.798 to 0.927. Ablations identify Q-matrix-guided cognitive supervision as the primary source of improvement, while AI-aware weighting further reduces overall MAE by 4.2% over the unweighted cognitive model and consistently improves MAE and QWK across the four most recent post-Gen-AI semesters.
articles.titleCn: 超越答案评分：面向自动数学简答题评分的人工智能感知认知监督框架
articles.abstractCn: 基于Transformer的语言模型在自动短答评分（ASAG）中取得了显著成功。然而，当前的ASAG方法在理解、推理和评估涉及符号和公式的复杂数学答案方面存在困难。这些仅评分的方法无法泛化到具有相同分数的不同响应和技能状态。此外，它们忽略了在评估学生表现和知识掌握时生成式人工智能（AI）可能引入的上偏倚。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了AICG（AI感知认知监督评分），这是一个双分支多任务框架。第一个分支结合了基于RoBERTa的回归、序数和分类头进行单答案评分。第二个分支使用专家设计的Q矩阵将响应与评估技能相关联，并联合预测基于G-DINA的技能掌握和学习收益。通过共享编码器，这些技能级目标为答案评分提供了超越分数标签的认知监督。AICG进一步使用一个通过监督对比预训练后进行线性分类训练的生成式AI检测器，以估计辅助概率并将它们转换为可靠性权重，在学习评估过程中减弱不可靠的认知证据。我们在跨越19个学期的49,402个教师评分的响应上进行了实验。与RoBERTa回归相比，AICG将平均绝对误差（MAE）降低了50.3%，并将二次加权kappa（QWK）从0.798提高到0.927。消融实验表明，Q矩阵引导的认知监督是改进的主要来源，而AI感知加权在不加权的认知模型上进一步将总体MAE降低了4.2%，并在四个最新的生成式AI学期中始终如一地提高了MAE和QWK。

articles.title: TRIDENT and SHAKTI: A Framework and Benchmark for Hindi AI-Text Detection
articles.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly multilingual, distinguishing human-written from AI-generated text is essential for maintaining information integrity. However, research remains English-centric, with limited benchmarks for low-resource languages such as Hindi. To address this gap, we introduce SHAKTI, a large-scale Hindi benchmark covering four genres, eight LLM families, multiple prompting strategies, and adversarial transformations. We evaluate its quality through human annotation and analyze linguistic, grammatical, and sentiment-based differences between human- and AI-generated texts. Building on these findings, we propose TRIDENT, a round-trip translation-based detection framework with three variants: TRIDENT-S (static threshold), TRIDENT-D (dynamic threshold), and TRIDENT-C (logistic regression using multi-distance RTT features). TRIDENT leverages semantic consistency between original and round-trip translated texts to identify AI-generated content. Extensive experiments show that TRIDENT outperforms conventional and supervised baselines, with TRIDENT-S achieving the best overall performance. Further evaluations across seven languages, adversarial settings, and unseen LLMs demonstrate its multilingual applicability and robustness, while highlighting sensitivity to the translation model.
articles.titleCn: TRIDENT和SHAKTI：一个用于印地语AI文本检测的框架和基准
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）日益多语种化，区分人类撰写文本与AI生成文本对于维护信息完整性至关重要。然而，研究仍以英语为中心，对印地语等低资源语言缺乏基准。为填补这一空白，我们引入SHAKTI，一个涵盖四种体裁、八种LLM家族、多种提示策略和对抗性转换的大规模印地语基准。我们通过人工标注评估其质量，并分析人类撰写文本与AI生成文本在语言、语法和情感方面的差异。基于这些发现，我们提出TRIDENT，一个基于往返翻译的检测框架，包含三种变体：TRIDENT-S（静态阈值）、TRIDENT-D（动态阈值）和TRIDENT-C（使用多距离往返翻译特征进行逻辑回归）。TRIDENT利用原始文本与往返翻译文本之间的语义一致性来识别AI生成内容。大量实验表明，TRIDENT优于传统和监督基线，其中TRIDENT-S表现最佳。进一步在七种语言、对抗性设置和未见过的LLM上的评估，展示了其多语种适用性和鲁棒性，同时也凸显了其对翻译模型的敏感性。
